mapper.sql: users.id, users.login_name, users.display_name, users.password_hash, users.primary_organization_id, organizations.organization_code, CASE WHEN users.is_enabled = 1 AND organizations.is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS account_enabled, users.must_change_password
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
SELECT FROM sys_user AS users INNER JOIN org_organization AS organizations ON organizations.id = users.primary_organization_id WHERE users.login_name = #{loginName}
SELECT FROM sys_user AS users INNER JOIN org_organization AS organizations ON organizations.id = users.primary_organization_id WHERE users.id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT role_permissions.permission_code FROM sys_user_role AS user_roles INNER JOIN sys_role AS roles ON roles.id = user_roles.role_id AND roles.is_enabled = 1 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission AS role_permissions ON role_permissions.role_id = roles.id WHERE user_roles.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role_permissions.permission_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_code, granted_by) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{permissionCode}, #{actor})
INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id, granted_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{actor})
INSERT INTO sys_user_organization_scope (user_id, organization_id, granted_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{organizationId}, #{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, must_change_password = 0, password_changed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_enabled = 1
